notes: **2026-09-01** — (branch `fix/F06-update-order-items-authorization-line-build`, merging master `e41a1e28`; no schema change) — **F06 updateOrderItems AUTHORIZATION + LINE BUILD (B47/B51/B60/B62/B63/B78).** One root cause: sibling methods gained guards that were never mirrored into the API's largest method or its buyer-portal caller. New pure **`orders/merge-items.ts`** — F30's `foldMergeItems`/`deriveUnitsPerBox` MOVED out of `orders.controller.ts` byte-identical (REG-B199 green UNMODIFIED) + `normalizeBoxUnawareSnapshots` and `normalizeBareIncomingSellingUnits`, because a box-UNAWARE line of a BOXED product states SELLING UNITS in `qty` while the fold adds a bare qty to `pieces`. **B47:** the buyer merge folds denomination-aware instead of summing `Number(li.qty)+item.qty` (2 boxes + a 1-box add billed 14 units at the BOX price, ~4.7x). **B51:** the CUSTOMER branch ignores client productId-null entries and preserves stored unlisted rows IN PLACE (deleteMany scoped to `productId not null`) — row ids survive, and it repairs a silent data loss where a buyer portal edit DROPPED operator-added unlisted lines. **B63:** a CUSTOMER items-edit on OUT_FOR_DELIVERY/PARTIALLY_DELIVERED/DELIVERED is refused 403 before ANY side effect; role-scoped, so DRIVER post-dispatch edits and CONFIRMED→PENDING are byte-identical. **B60 — the register premise was WRONG:** `loadActivePromotions` is `[]` for staff by design (P5-04), so the documented "PROMO billed at full price" case is unreachable; the real defect is the staff replaceAll block DESTROYING buyer-earned `promoFreeUnits`. It now preserves + rescales via `rescaleBogoFreeUnits`, ⚠️ **keyed to UNAMBIGUOUS pairs only** (one pre-edit line AND one incoming line per product) — the Fable final pass caught that a productId-keyed map handed the snapshot and the override attribution to a sibling line that never earned one (no-op save billed it 20.00 instead of 25.00); a replaceAll payload carries no line ids, so there is no sound N-to-N mapping and any other shape falls through rather than guessing. **B78:** `applyBuyerMergeHeader` carries notes (append) / urgent (only-sets-true) / requestedDeliveryDate onto the merged order before the sibling sweep; the DTO was deliberately NOT extended. **B62 (T2):** the order-edit page gates its add + substitute controls on `pricingReady` (customer queries settled; errored counts as ready so a failure cannot wedge the editor), MIRRORED onto the mobile operator edit-items screen — that half needs an Expo build. ⚠️ **Three residuals filed, not fixed, with reasons at the call sites:** a bare buyer qty for a product with NO stored line (re-split as PIECES by a pre-F06 clause — needs a client-contract decision), the STAFF scan-merge's unnormalized stored side (R12 froze it byte-identical), and the fold's price-survival contract being inert on the buyer path (the CUSTOMER branch re-prices and never reads `item.unitPrice`, so an operator MANUAL courtesy price does not survive a buyer merge — fix belongs in F07's region).
